source: Direct human request; numeric per-species global sequence and no desktop name/number

scope.counter: independent per immutable canonical original templateId across all users

wild.entityKey: server-validated world/scenario + ownerAccountId + stable spawnId; not client nickname, resourceId or transient permitId
wild.acrossUsers: different owner-scoped wild instances at same map cell receive different numbers
wild.allocation: Nearby map points remain candidates until the user opens an encounter. A server-validated observe operation assigns the number before battle/capture, using the existing location and interaction-range policy. Refresh, reserve, re-entry and retry reuse it; do not batch-allocate numbers on every nearby refresh.
wild.capture: bind captured ownerAccountId + existing petId to the SAME allocated wild globalSerial; never allocate again

preservation.storage: Authoritative sidecar registry and a non-backup main-process cache. Project confirmed numbers into read-only DTOs; never embed them retroactively in original pet data_json, immutable action receipts or archived envelopes.
preservation.offline: no local fabricated global number; unconfirmed number stays absent/pending
preservation.untrustedImport: unverified client/imported numeric metadata cannot assert authority

namespace.qa: qa:<scenarioId>; only server service-owned authorization grants select this scope, never editable usernames or user_metadata
namespace.revocation: Expired or revoked QA authorization cannot silently fall back to allocating production numbers

responsibilities.02: shared types, companion DTO/display helper, no desktop visible labels; coordinate local authoritative cache with 08
responsibilities.03: discovery nearby/encounter/capture same-number UI and server integration; no competing registry SQL
responsibilities.08: private atomic registry, transactional numbering/backfill, trusted sync/readback, incremental migration; deploy only after root review
responsibilities.09: independent real application scenarios, concurrency/identity/readback proofs
